svg.aria-label: Running: the open-circuit potential is measured first, with Cell On not lit. Once the frequency sweep starts, the yellow Cell On light comes on and Nyquist points appear one by one from high to low frequency. Do not touch the leads during the measurement; if Overload stays lit, check the clips.
